factor_name: 90-Day Recovery Velocity Adjusted for Downside Risk

calculation.description: Measures rebound from the trailing 90-session low, scaled by recent downside volatility. The one-session lag ensures only completed information is used. Higher values indicate stronger recovery per unit of downside risk.

validation.regime_notes: 1-day IC by regime: 2020-2022 +0.01536 (713 dates), 2023-2024 +0.00278 (516 dates), 2025-2027 +0.00582 (647 dates). The daily gate passes, but regime strength is weaker after 2022; 10-day predictive strength is materially higher.
